## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      11 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Apr 20, 2026 - Sep 2, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. __pulliam__, Aug 31, 2026, 1/5: "From insanely slow loading to constant crashes… I can’t waste more time listing all the things that do not work with this app. I’m baffled how, in 2026, a tech company with a great product can’t figure out mobile. I need to just fully migrate to google docs and just be done with this mess."
            2. _.oliviaaa_, Aug 15, 2026, 1/5: "There's a lot of issues on mobile compared to the desktop version. For example, when you select a paragraph and try to delete it instead of holding down the delete button, it doesn't delete. Sometimes even when you hold down the delete button, a letter or two doesn't get deleted. It's generally laggy and without a premium subscription, you can't even upload a single video as the file max is 10mb and most videos are over that. You have to find a site and register to embed the videos instead. Overall greedy platform. Used to be good until it became buggy and you're can't upload a video without the app's premium subscription being shoved down your throat."
            3. _AS-QV_, Aug 13, 2026, 1/5: "Lot of bugs like emoji selection failures, Formatting text on the phone. Notion used to be the minimalist note taking app with seamless UX. Now, it's like any other tech company. Product is pushing to add more features for the cost of reduced usability to boost internal KPIs. Save Notion or I'm out to Obsidian!"
<!--/ir-theme-->
